Title: Prompty: Server-Side Template Injection to Remote Code Execution in the @prompty/core Nunjucks Renderer
Description: The TypeScript Nunjucks renderer evaluated untrusted `.prompty` template bodies with unrestricted JavaScript member access. An attacker-controlled template could traverse constructor and prototype properties to execute JavaScript in the host Node.js process.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 0.1.5, all versions starting from 2.0.0-alpha.1 before 2.0.0-beta.5
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 0.1.5 before 2.0.0-alpha.1, all versions starting from 2.0.0-beta.5
